mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production relative to its 3-month moving average signals weakening economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns show a positive correlation with INDPRO levels (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% (p-value > 0.05 for mean return being negative).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (below 4.5%) and elevated consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL above 210) signals a stagflationary environment, where monetary policy is ineffective at stimulating growth without fueling inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 210 AND FEDFUNDS < 4.5), or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a slowdown in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals the onset of economic deceleration, which triggers a sell-off in equities as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate is below 1.0% during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC between the signal and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A continuous decline in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) relative to its 6-month moving average signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns show a positive correlation with PAYEMS levels (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units signals a contraction in the residential sector, which reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 1,200,000, or the Rank IC between HOUST and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in retail sales (RSAFS < 370,000 million dollars) and housing starts (HOUST < 1,200,000 units) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS < 370000 AND HOUST < 1200), or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.0% during high unemployment regimes, or the Rank IC between the signal and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
